candidates.name: National LIDAR Programme
verified_facts: The National LIDAR Programme divided England into survey blocks and captured Phase 1 nationally between 2017 and 2023, with later repeat phases driven by update needs.
Survey products are published with block/phase coverage metadata rather than implying one single acquisition date for all England.
semantic_limits: National coverage does not mean a uniform survey epoch; parcel results must retain the exact block, phase and survey date used.

candidates.name: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: The time-stamped DSM archive contains survey-specific raster tiles at 25cm, 50cm, 1m or 2m depending on project requirements.
Its metadata identifies survey date, product resolution and the transformation/geoidal model used; DSM values include surface objects and carry the stated +/-15cm RMSE LIDAR accuracy contract.
semantic_limits: A time-stamped DSM remains a surface model, not bare-earth terrain, and its exact survey/transformation metadata must be matched before any parcel use.
